title: Coyote Swapped and Flared Badass 1967 Mustang Fastback
description: You guys probably know that I love a well done Mustang and this one fits the bill. Art has been building this one on and off for 6 years and it's really close to being complete. He takes us for a walk through of the build which features a Coyote swap, beautiful flares to the fenders & quarters, Detroit Speed Suspension and a ton of custom fabrication. Sit back and enjoy this one...  For Merch go to www.atlamerch.com  AutotopiaLA Social Media:  Instagram https://www.instagram.com/autotopiala/ Facebook https://www.facebook.com/autotopiala/ Web https://www.autotopiala.com  Paul Welsh - Videography & Tech support: https://www.instagram.com/mr.paulwelsh  Edited by Kyle Simon: https://www.instagram.com/_kylesimon https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCqZ...  Vehicle Builder and Owner Social: https://www.instagram.com/t34speed  Music: "Love and War" - Chester Malone Epidemic Sound https://www.epidemicsound.com  We want to hear from you. Like the music? Like the cars? Like the locations? Tell us what you'd like to see and we'll do our best to bring it to you as we continue creating content. Thanks for watching and help spread the word by telling your friends to check out AutotopiaLA! New episode every Tuesday and Friday at 5 pm (pst).
